# aikido_container_clone (Resource)

Clones an existing Aikido container with its own tag filter, so that several tags of one image are scanned. Only containers from a connected registry can be cloned. The clone starts active and is scanned right away; manage its other settings with an aikido_container on the clone's ID. Destroy deactivates the clone, which stays available in Aikido. To scan that tag again, reactivate the existing clone with an aikido_container on its ID rather than cloning it again. Clones already made in the Aikido UI can be imported as <source_container_id>:<clone_id>; the aikido_containers data source finds a clone's ID by the source container's name and registry plus the clone's tag_filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Scan several tags of one registry image. The source container keeps its own
# tag filter, and each extra tag gets a clone.
resource "aikido_container" "api" {
  id         = "12345"
  active     = true
  tag_filter = "prod-*"
}

resource "aikido_container_clone" "api" {
  for_each = toset(["staging-*", "semver-production"])

  source_container_id = 12345
  tag_filter          = each.value
}

# Clones do not inherit labels, sensitivity or connectivity. Configure them with
# aikido_container, leaving tag_filter out so the clone keeps its own filter.
resource "aikido_container" "api_clones" {
  for_each = aikido_container_clone.api

  id          = each.value.id
  active      = true
  sensitivity = "sensitive"
  labels      = ["api"]
}

# A clone already made in the Aikido UI is managed with aikido_container. It
# shares the source container's name and registry, and its tag filter tells it
# apart from the other clones.
data "aikido_containers" "api_release" {
  name        = "pied-piper/api"
  registry_id = 67
  tag_filter  = "release-*"
}

resource "aikido_container" "api_release" {
  id     = one(data.aikido_containers.api_release.containers).id
  active = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_container_id` (Number) Aikido container ID of the container to clone.
- `tag_filter` (String) Tag filter deciding which image the clone scans. Supports * wildcards, for example prod-*, and the special value semver-production. Aikido rejects a tag that another clone of the same image in the same registry already carries.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Aikido container ID of the clone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Clones are imported as source_container_id:clone_id, including clones made in
# the Aikido UI. The clone must share the source container's name and registry.
terraform import 'aikido_container_clone.api["release-*"]' 12345:12399
```
